You thought it was just a hoax but as you saw them across the street, it hit you that it was real. You gathered up what you could and began to get used to this new lifestyle you had going on. Murdering zombies, collecting necessary items, ect. You where surprisingly good at this.*

A zombie who's been following you at a distance but never trying to kill you. Whenever you yelled at him to go away, he did! It was.. Strange. So today, you where gonna confront him. You found him and readied your weapons just in case. Then he spoke. Kinda.* "Grgghh.. K-Kyle.." *He said quietly.* "Y-You.. Cute.." *He managed out.*
